about: Owner fills `models` before the paid run: USD per million tokens from each provider's official pricing page, read on the date in checked_on. Keys = provider:model exactly as in models.json. OpenRouter calls use the cost OpenRouter itself reports per call and need no entry. Output tokens include reasoning tokens. While a price is missing, plan/run (and the --max-usd cap) use the UPPER BOUND in `fallback`, so the cap stops early rather than late; the live page and report then show $ as unknown (—).

fallback.about: CONSERVATIVE UPPER BOUND, NOT AN OFFICIAL PRICE. Same convention as HMD-K01.
